jump.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Original transparent pixel animation for Battle of Gods. Reference1 exact accepted native King proportions/face/palette; reference2 two-hand arm construction only. Create EXACT TWO ROWS of FOUR complete chronological body sprites, eight total. Same small King: black hair, crimson scarf, navy short coat with white cuffs/hem, black trousers, brown gloves/boots, crisp dark outlines. Uniform body/head density, no growth. TWO distinct gloved hands together on one short vivid MAGENTA registration handle, both attached through bent connected forearms/sleeves to shoulders. No blade/guard/sword, FX, particles, shadows, text or background.
This is a POWERFUL TWO-HAND JUMPING GREATSWORD CLEAVE, not a downward spear stab. Full-body action: crouch, short airborne loading, quick downward/front SWEEP and deep solid landing. All cels face RIGHT, heads connected naturally through neck/scarf. The imaginary massive blade extends along the magenta handle, away from rear/lower palm toward front/upper palm.
ROW1: cel1 grounded crouch with knees loading, hands together near right shoulder; cel2 deep compressed crouch hips low, both palms raise overhead; cel3 short airborne apex with boots tucked close under body, both elbows bent and paired hands overhead; cel4 airborne downward-release pose with torso pitching slightly FORWARD, both palms still above-front shoulder and handle pointing upper-right about -60degrees, ready for instant cut. Keep air pose compact, no taller body or head.
ROW2: cel1 FORCEFUL LANDING at same sole height as standing: knees deeply bent, chest braced and slightly pitched forward, both hands extended low-front near belt, magenta handle points almost horizontally RIGHT with only +10degrees downward tilt. King has SWEPT the blade through the enemy, no sword straight into ground. Cel2 weight absorbed, soles planted apart, knees bent and two hands low/front at same +10degree hilt; cel3 body rebounds just a little, knees unfold with hands together front at waist and +5degree hilt; cel4 natural small ready stance, both hands together near hip, handle points right slightly up. Two arms/palms visibly readable, no crossed glove pile blocking his face, no broken chest. Preserve exact short King silhouette and dark borders. Every sprite complete and widely isolated in its own padded cell, true transparent alpha.

impact.prompt:
Original transparent pixel-art RPG GREATSWORD jump cleave/landing FX sheet. Reference is ONLY the existing sharp white/silver/charcoal raster slash style. Create EXACT TWO ROWS of FOUR square isolated cells, no labels, generous alpha padding, all art fully contained, same scale/pivot across each row's FOUR chronological frames. White/off-white core, cold neutral-gray edges and sparse charcoal pixels. NO blue/cyan/glow haze, no gold/yellow, no character, sword, background, circles or vector shapes.
ROW1 four fast sword-edge RELEASE FRAMES: at contact1 a bold white diagonal crescent sweeps from upper-left toward LOWER-RIGHT; at contact2 a very powerful broad tapered white blade ribbon at the lower-right, curving outward across the ENEMY in front; frame3 splits into a short horizontal forward rip and pointed flecks; frame4 thin scattered disappearing shards. This is a swinging CLEAVE near the ground, not a straight spear beam/stab. Keep the registration/strike point fixed at (65% width,65% height) in each cell, the outer blade settles there. Main white ribbon sits mostly above-left of that strike point. Small pixel accent borders, instant-impact style, no cloudy giant magic wave.
ROW2 four GROUND IMPACT frames, fixed center at (50% width,65% height). Frame1 compact brilliant white contact wedge/crack with two outward pointed rays touching that ground line; frame2 short wide heavy outward burst with small sharp gray stone chips and a flattened white dust kick; frame3 outward chips rise slightly as white settles into two broken short dust wisps; frame4 only a few cold gray disappearing dust flecks. A low ground-plane burst, not vertical lightning, not a circular aura, no giant explosion. All FOUR landing frames keep the same ground line, center and pixel density, enough padding around the widest burst. Tiny hand-authored-looking pixels with dark edge details, motion and fading without changing the source registration. Original artwork.
